products.name: Abridge (MTD for Excel/Sheets)
products.price_note: Full MTD Coverage plan: quarterly updates and final declaration, from Excel, Google Sheets or file upload.

products.name: Absolute Excel Income Tax Filer
products.price_note: Price covers 5 National Insurance numbers for a tax year.

products.name: Accounting from Sage
products.price_note: Sage Accounting Start (for VAT-registered sole traders or small businesses), then Standard £43 and Plus £59 a month excl. VAT. Offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for 10 months (£2/month excl. 20% VAT), or skip the offer for a 30-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate via Impact.com. Not stated on Sage's official page. Official FAQ names Sage Business Cloud Accounting (SBCA) and Sage Intacct as commissionable; Accounting from Sage is Sage's SBCA product.

products.name: Acorah Software Products Ltd (TaxCalc)
products.price_note: TaxCalc MTD Quarterly Filer is aimed at accountants filing for clients from spreadsheets.

products.name: Aligned.tax MTD for Spreadsheets
products.price_note: Filing your own quarterly updates is free for individuals; accountants pay per client from the 2027/28 tax year.

products.name: ANNA Self Assessment
products.price_note: ANNA's Free plan is £0/month ('pay for what you use') and lists 'MTD ITSA filing – free'. Optional Auto Accountant (prepares and files your MTD updates for you): first 4 months free, then £29/month. Paid business plans from £12.90 a month + VAT. Needs an ANNA account.

affiliate_programme.note: introducer / affiliate (cash commission; open to individuals) via In-house. Business account: £130 per sole trader, £175 per limited company (£200 after 20+ Ltd referrals in a calendar month). Auto Accountant: £100 Premium / £50 Self Assessment plan, paid after subscription (not during trial). Paid after AML checks and, where applicable, a £20 deposit. Official intro page and 12 June 2026 blog.

products.name: Basetax – Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
Clear Books
products.price_note: Sole Trader £5/month, Property £5/month, Sole Trader Plus (VAT-registered) £15/month, all excl. VAT. 30-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: No public publisher programme or published commission found on 23 Nov 2026. Terms of Use (last updated 26 May 2022), clause 13, say Clear Books may run an affiliate scheme in which subscribers receive a benefit (not stated) when a referred person signs up and pays. Accountants, bookkeepers and resellers are not eligible. No public sign-up page was found.

products.name: Clear Books Free
products.price_note: Sole Trader Free, Property Free and Foreign Property Free (one property) plans at £0.

products.name: Coconut
products.price_note: MTD Bridging plan £49.99/year (quarterly updates from a spreadsheet; year-end submission is a £49.99 add-on). MTD filing plan £12.99/month or £129.99/year. 14-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: No public publisher affiliate programme found on 23 Nov 2026. The accountant Partner Programme is for practices. The customer refer-a-friend scheme (help article 9 Feb 2026) gives monthly-paying customers one free month, not a cash commission. The Partners page is aimed at brands wanting exposure to Coconut's audience.

products.name: Coconut Free
products.price_note: HMRC lists a free Coconut product; its limits were not checked.

products.name: FreeAgent
products.price_note: Prices for UK sole traders and unincorporated landlords. Intro offer at check: 50% off for the first six months. 30-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: No public publisher affiliate programme found. The customer referral scheme (terms updated 3 Feb 2026) gives a 10% subscription discount, not a cash commission, and is for existing subscribers only; terms forbid distributing a code in exchange for payment. The Partner Programme is for accountants and bookkeepers only.

products.name: FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest & RBS
products.price_note: Free while you keep a NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland or Ulster Bank business current account, or a Mettle account with at least one transaction a month.

products.name: GetGround
products.price_note: MTD for landlords free with GetGround's Basic plan.

products.name: Hammock for landlords
products.price_note: 30-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: No public publisher affiliate programme found on 23 Nov 2026. Letting-agent and accountant pages invite recommendations or licence discounts but do not publish a publisher commission. Partner terms (updated 20 Oct 2022) are a reseller-style arrangement in which the partner pays Hammock subscription fees.

products.name: IRIS Kashflow
products.price_note: Starter plan £13.50/month ('Ideal for sole traders, contractors and small businesses'). Offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for 6 months (£1.35/month). 14-day free trial. The page doesn't say whether VAT is added.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate via In-house. £2 per confirmed monthly paid subscription, recurring each month the user renews; £50 minimum payout; cheque or bank transfer. Cookie length not stated on the affiliate FAQ (a separate customer referrals help article mentions a 999-day cookie for referral links — that article is not the publisher programme page).

products.name: Landlord Studio
products.price_text: Free up to 3 properties + £5 per MTD submission; Pro £12 + VAT/month
products.price_note: MTD Go plan is free for up to 3 properties but charges £5 per MTD tax submission. Pro £12 + VAT/month (£144 a year + VAT) includes free MTD submissions; 14-day free trial, no card needed.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate (Affiliate Referral Program) via FirstPromoter. One-time £40 GBP per qualifying UK customer (or $50 USD for US). Qualifying = new account via the link and a paid Pro or Pro Plus plan (annual not refunded after 30 days, or fourth monthly payment), within 12 months. 45-day cookie. PayPal; minimum £80 / $100. Open to individuals 18+. Terms updated 28 October 2026. Accountant Partner Programme is separate and for accountants only.

products.name: Landlord Vision
products.price_note: Starter plan (4 tenancies) £7.99/month with '60% off for the 2 years' and a 2-year price guarantee, against £19.97. Prices exclusive of VAT. Every plan includes full MTD functionality. 2-week free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate via FirstPromoter. 20% of each of the first 12 monthly qualifying payments, or 20% of the first annual payment only (no annual renewals). 1-year cookie. No minimum payout. Paid on the 30th to bank or PayPal. Free to join; manual approval. Terms updated 23 October 2026.

products.name: MTD Sheets
products.price_note: First submission free, then £2.99 per submission (from 49p each in bulk).

products.name: My Business Finances, powered by Sage
My Tax Digital (Free)
products.price_note: Describes itself as free MTD software for Income Tax and VAT, with a bridging mode that imports spreadsheet figures.

products.name: Pandle
products.price_note: Free Pandle plan; Pandle Pro £5/month + VAT.

products.name: PaTMa Property Manager
products.price_note: Free plan covers 1 rental unit. Pro £15/month for 5 units (extra units £1.50/unit/month). All prices include VAT. 14-day Pro trial, no card needed.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate via In-house. 25% of referred revenue for the first year (active paid subscriptions, excluding VAT); 90-day cookie. Referrals get £10/month off for the first three months. Commission notified one month after each quarter; affiliate invoices; paid within 10 days. Review in a couple of working days.

products.name: Provestor for Landlords
products.price_note: DIY plan shown at £69 for the first year with a £99/year regular price. Check VAT basis on the source page.

products.name: QuickBooks (Intuit)
products.price_note: Sole Trader Plus is £10/month and Simple Start is £18/month (list prices). Sole Trader Plus can't submit VAT returns. Every plan includes 'Calculate and submit CIS' and a 30-day free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: UK publisher programme listed as Active on FlexOffers on 23 Nov 2026. Payout 16% of online sales and free trials (QBOA accountant purchases excluded); 30-day cookie; paid in USD. FlexOffers terms (updated 15 June 2026) pay monthly on NET 60 and require a verified live traffic source. Programme page last update 12 January 2026.

products.name: RentalBux Free
products.price_note: Free plan for basic MTD compliance. Joint ownership splits are on paid plans.

products.name: Sage Sole Trader & Landlord
products.price_note: Sage Sole Trader plan, £7/month excl. VAT. Intro offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for 10 months (£0.70/month excl. 20% VAT), then £7/month.

affiliate_programme.note: Official Sage UK & Ireland Affiliate Programme for publishers and comparison sites, tracked and paid via Impact.com; free to join. Official page does not publish commission or cookie length. FAQ names Sage Business Cloud Accounting (SBCA) and Sage Intacct as commissionable. Read 23 Nov 2026.

products.name: Sage Sole Trader & Landlord Free
products.price_note: Sage Sole Trader Free: 'Completely free, no billing.' 25 auto-categorised transactions per month, 1 bank account, records landlord income and expenses, Making Tax Digital ready.

affiliate_programme.note: Covered by the same Sage UK & Ireland Affiliate Programme (Impact.com) as the paid product; free to join. Official FAQ names SBCA and Sage Intacct as commissionable; whether the free Sole Trader MTD product pays is not stated on Sage's official page. Commission and cookie length are not published there. Read 23 Nov 2026.

products.name: TaxBridge UK MTD by Amelia GB
TaxPig
products.price_note: Free Community Edition (£0/month, 50 receipt scans). TaxPig Pro £7.50/month.

products.name: Taxzap
products.price_note: For non-VAT-registered sole traders and landlords.

products.name: Tide Accounting
products.price_note: Tide's MTD for Income Tax features are built into its free business account ('Everything you need to stay MTD-compliant, completely free'), including automated quarterly submissions; you can connect another bank via Open Banking. Accounting add-on plans: £0.00/month for sole traders, then £5.99 + VAT/month and up. One-month free trial of Admin Extra.

affiliate_programme.note: publisher affiliate via Impact.com (Impact Radius). £50 CPA for each new Tide member successfully onboarded. Cookie length not stated on the public page. Application is free; comparison sites are invited. Sign-up is described as a form in the Tide app/web app after visiting the programme page.

products.name: VitalTax
products.price_note: Excel add-in. One NI number £30 + VAT per year, covering all quarterly submissions for that person; unlimited licence £198 + VAT.

products.name: Xero
products.price_note: Ignite plan, then £18/month excl. VAT. Intro offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for the first 6 months (£1.80/month excl. VAT); the page also offers one month free. Ignite lists 'MTD for Income Tax ready' and CIS calculations.

affiliate_programme.note: Official UK publisher/review-site programme hosted on PartnerStack; free to join. Xero's own page does not publish a rate (discussed after joining). PartnerStack programme directory listed $200 per qualified purchase on 23 Nov 2026. Agreement: a new non-accounting/bookkeeping business signs up via the link and buys a paying Business Edition subscription within 35 days. Cookie length not stated.

products.name: Zoho
products.price_text: Free plan; paid from £10/month billed annually
products.price_note: Zoho Books Free plan is £0 and lists MTD for Income Tax (Sole Traders & Landlords tab). Standard plan is £10/org/month billed annually (£12 billed monthly), with a free trial.

affiliate_programme.note: In-house Zoho Affiliate Program, open to individuals and website owners. Standard tier 15% of revenue/list price for the first 12 months (18% and 20% higher tiers); 90-day cookie; 60-day stickiness; free to join. Applications reviewed within five business days. Agreement last updated 7 October 2026. Read 23 Nov 2026.
